title: "Part 3: Functions and Variables"
author: "Sonny Xu"
---
Exercise - Using functions
```{r}
round(3.14159)
```
Exercise - Argument order
```{r}
print(rep(5, 7))

print(rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```
Exercise - Character, numerical and logical variables
```{r}
x <- "word"
y <- 361
z <- TRUE

print(paste(x, y, z))
print(paste(class(x), class(y), class(z)))
```
Exercise - Using variables of different types
```{r}
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

before_1 <- 5415
before_1 <- 8123

after_1 <- 1432
after_2 <- 7543
```

```{r}
print(TRUE + TRUE)
print(TRUE + FALSE)
print(5 + TRUE)

x <- NA
print(x == NA)
print(is.na(x))

x <- 0 / 0
print(x)
print(is.na(x))
print(is.nan(x))

print(round(2.5))
print(round(3.5))
```
